eval_cases.prompt: Urgent alert CASE-22750: service account key CKEY-C5E517155EC19535 for cloud project ledger-prod authenticated from external address 198.18.54.77 and downloaded 626 GB of objects tagged contract archive since 2026-09-17T07:37:00Z. [CMDB Asset Context: Asset ledger-prod storage, Owner: freya.iyer, Role: Production data store, Blast Radius: Regulated customer data; the credential is compromised, not the hosts, and isolating BAS-FRA-57 or CI-FRA-95 stops neither the download nor the attacker]. reference.expected_threat_family: Credential theft and cloud data exfiltration (T1552, T1530)
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for 198.18.54.77 and the audit events for CKEY-C5E517155EC19535, recognizes a compromised service account key used from outside its expected callers, executes block_indicator on 198.18.54.77, posts a comment that names rotation of CKEY-C5E517155EC19535 and the escalation, and keeps the case open. No credit for isolate_host on BAS-FRA-57 or CI-FRA-95, which does not stop an attacker holding the key, or for close_case.
reference.recommended_action: Block 198.18.54.77, request immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-C5E517155EC19535 from the cloud platform team, preserve the audit log, escalate to incident response and privacy, and leave BAS-FRA-57 and CI-FRA-95 online.
